description: Call My Dog provides behavioral consultations, in-home training and an educational dog school in Vila Clementino, São Paulo. Founded by biologist Samara Arsego, the center offers structured routines including basic obedience, impulse control exercises, treadmill conditioning and socialization. Specialized programs also cover intensive boarding training and online sessions for families.
